app.tagline: Circles over your prices until they drop.

search.placeholder: Search a product, paste a URL or EAN…
search.followHint: Gier finds trustworthy stores and first checks it has the right product.

detail.adviceCost: Claude Haiku · total for this product {{cost}}
detail.noAdvice: No advice yet. Without AI the deal verdict applies.
detail.stopConfirm: Gier stops tracking. History is kept.
detail.seller: sold by {{name}}, not by the store itself
detail.blockedHint: This store does not allow automatic price checks. Check the price yourself with Go to store.

finding.raised_before_sale: Raised first: just before the sale it was {{before}}, now {{now}}.
finding.inflated_percentage: Claims {{claimed}}% off, really {{real}}% versus the 30-day low ({{low30}}).
finding.unused_list_price: List price {{listPrice}} is charged by no tracked store (highest seen: {{highestSeen}}).
finding.inflated_was_price: Inflated was-price: {{wasPrice}}, but the 30-day low was {{low30}}.
finding.label_without_drop: ‘{{label}}’ without a price drop: already {{lowWeek}} last week.
finding.endless_sale: Sale has been running for {{days}} days.
finding.insufficient_history: Not enough history yet ({{days}} of {{needed}} days) to test the discount.

wizard.confirmTitle: Do you mean exactly this product?
wizard.searching: Gier is working out what you mean…
wizard.attrsHint: Locked attributes must match at every store. Tap to loosen.
wizard.multipack: Include multipacks and convert to price per item
wizard.learned: Excluded automatically, learned from your earlier choices
wizard.name: Name
wizard.excluded: Not trusted or a different product
wizard.noneFound: No stores found yet. Is SearXNG configured? You can also paste a product link.
wizard.budgetTitle: How much may Gier spend on this?
wizard.aiBudgetHint: For recognising, doubtful matches and buying advice. Searching via SearXNG is free.
wizard.estimate: Expected ± {{cost}} per month (weekly re-discovery and a few pieces of advice with Claude Haiku).
wizard.estimateNone: No AI costs. Advice becomes the deal verdict; Gier asks you about doubtful cases.
wizard.adviceAuto: Automatic advice while one costs less than {{max}}; more expensive only on request.
wizard.searchingHint: Gier is looking the product up. This usually takes up to half a minute.
wizard.backgroundHint: A first search can take a few minutes. You do not have to wait: close the app or do something else, Gier sends a notification when it is done.
wizard.unreadHint: These shops may sell the product, but Gier could not read the price. Open the page to check, or add the link yourself.

stores.title: Store registry
stores.intro: Every store that passes a discovery ends up here. For a new product Gier searches these stores first.
stores.loginHelp: Log in to the store in the window below. Gier only keeps the session, encrypted, never your password.
stores.loginDone: Logged in. Gier uses this session for checks.
stores.browserRunMissing: Cloudflare Browser Run is not configured (CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN).
stores.preferenceHint: Only count this store as cheapest when it is at least this much cheaper than the next store.
stores.loginExpired: The login window expired. Start again when you are ready.
stores.remoteTypeHint: First tap the field in the store window above, then type here and tap send. Your text goes straight to that field via your own Gier server and is not stored.

errors.browser_run_not_configured: Cloudflare Browser Run is not configured (CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN).
errors.browser_run_rate_limited: Cloudflare is still busy with an earlier browser. Wait about half a minute and try again.
errors.browser_run_daily_limit: The daily Browser Run allowance of your Cloudflare plan is used up. Try again tomorrow.
errors.browser_run_unauthorized: Cloudflare refused the API token. Check that it has the "Browser Run: Edit" permission.
errors.browser_run_failed: Starting the browser at Cloudflare failed. Try again in a moment.
errors.login_url_outside_store: The login page must be on the store's own website.

stores.loginPageEdit: Change the page where the login starts
stores.loyaltyCard: I have this store's loyalty card

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.quiet: Quiet hours 22:00–07:00: only top deals come through.

costs.title: Costs · {{month}}
costs.intro: No fixed costs. Only AI tokens and occasional fallback searches, tracked per product.
costs.ruleAdvice: Buying advice runs automatically while it costs less than {{max}} on average.
costs.ruleProduct: Budget per product from the wizard; when it runs out, the deal verdict takes over.
costs.ruleTotal: Overall cap of {{cap}} per month for everything.
costs.none: No AI costs yet this month.

settings.title: Settings
settings.pushHint: On iPhone/iPad first use Share › Add to Home Screen, then open Gier from that icon.
settings.pushUnsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
settings.notice: Based on Gier by Martijn Cornips — Apache-2.0
settings.pushNoKey: No VAPID key on the server.

services.searxng: Self-hosted and free. Main search source (SEARXNG_URL).
services.brave: Fallback, per query, within the monthly cap (BRAVE_API_KEY).
services.ai: Recognition, doubtful matches and buying advice (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).
services.push: Gier creates the VAPID keys itself on first start (secrets.json).
services.telegram: Fallback when push is not possible (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + _CHAT_ID).

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.hint: Alerts in Telegram via the shared Gier bot, for you only.
telegram.waiting: Tap Start in Telegram. This page updates by itself.
telegram.failed: The Telegram service cannot be reached right now.

welcome.title: Gier keeps searching when you stop.
welcome.intro: Search a product once. Gier finds the trustworthy stores, keeps an eye on them and tells you whether a discount is real.
welcome.install: Add Gier to your home screen
welcome.pushHint: Only for deals and your thresholds
welcome.installIos: In Safari: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen". Needed for notifications on iPhone.

common.crashTitle: Something went wrong on this screen
common.crashHint: The rest of Gier still works. Try again, or go back to the overview.
common.signedOutHint: Sign in again to see your products. Gier keeps tracking prices meanwhile.

errors.offline: You are offline. Gier will try again when the connection is back.
errors.network_error: Gier cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.unexpected_response: Gier sent an unexpected answer. Try again, or reload the app.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server.

reason.too_long: Too much data for one piece of advice
reason.tier_none: AI is off for this product
reason.product_cap: This product's budget is used up this month
reason.recent: Advice is less than 12 hours old

install.title: Install Gier as an app
install.iosAfter: and then "Add to Home Screen". iPhone only sends notifications to installed apps.
install.prompt: Opens full screen and can send you notifications.
install.manual: Open the browser menu and choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.hint: Something broken, unclear or missing? Tell us. It goes straight to the backlog.
feedback.placeholder: What happened, and what did you expect?
feedback.privacy: Sent along: this page, the app version, your screen size and browser. Not your email address.
feedback.thanks: Thanks! Your feedback has been sent.
feedback.tooMany: You sent several messages just now. Try again in a few minutes.

build.refreshHint: Tap to reload the app completely from the server
